items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 October 2026 9:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 13 October 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Rapidly deepening area of low pressure approaching Iceland as a ridge of high pressure covers much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest, backing south or southwest overnight, 4 or 5, steadily increasing 6 or 7 tomorrow morning and occasionally gale 8 in the north later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 6 to gale 8, gradually veering west or northwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain soon developing, heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
